snippet.title: Home Paige - 3D Platformer Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Home Paige is a narrative-driven 3D Platformer set inside an operating system.

Movement Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4098960/Home_Paige/
Kickstarter (Funded!): https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/minimin/home-paige-chapter-1

This trailer was made for Home Paige: Chapter 1's Kickstarter, which hit its goal of $18,000 in 47 minutes, raising a total of $128,018 to fund development. Thank you!

Created by Minimin.
